summary: Raleigh County tower erected by CCC crews in early 1935; NHLR-registered 1998; now used only in emergencies, on Beaver Coal Company land.

facts.design: 80-foot Aermotor steel tower with 7 by 7 foot cab; CCC built a log observer's cabin

events.note: First road and trail built under a federal forest-work program during the Depression
Erected by CCC Camp Wyoming Company 1538 in about ten days, late January 1935; the register gives 1934
Approximate: a November 1953 item says the observer was on the tower two years earlier
Registered June 1, 1998; nominated by Jim Circle, District Forester

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the CCC built the tower in 1934, the year after the 1933 road. February 1935 newspaper reports describe it as newly erected in late January 1935. The event uses 1935 and the story notes the disagreement.

notes_for_editor: Access and visiting status unknown; the register says emergency use only on Beaver Coal Company land, and no public visiting or rental information was found. The newspaper clippings are secondhand, transcribed on the Forest Lookouts site, not checked against the original papers. The build year conflicts (register 1934, clippings Jan 1935). A Facebook group post claiming a 2012 observation could not be read, so it is not used. Mapcarta gives 2,654 ft elevation against the register's 2,637 ft; not used. No record corrections proposed.
